description: Hero3D now generates stable seeded floating positions in code. This file only controls visibility and optional targetRadius per model.

position.x: generated once by LayoutGenerator; biased toward the right half of the hero
position.y: generated once by LayoutGenerator; floating height
position.z: generated once by LayoutGenerator; depth for parallax

coordinateSystem.rotation: generated once by LayoutGenerator; radians, Babylon.js convention
